2607.21324.title: GRADRAG: Cross-Component Prompt Adaptation for Coordinated Multi-Agent RAG
2607.21324.paper_summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems increasingly employ multiple LLM agents. Yet, most prior work optimizes components in isolation rather than coordinating improvements across the pipeline. We introduce GRADRAG, a framework for cross-component prompt adaptation that models the RAG pipeline as a computational graph and propagates structured evaluation feedback to update upstream agents. An Evaluator critiques downstream answers and supporting evidence, producing actionable feedback that a Prompt Optimizer uses to iteratively update adaptive agents, such as retrievers, graph constructors, and answerers. The Evaluator also triggers early stopping when the output is deemed satisfactory. We evaluate GRADRAG on the SQUALITY and QMSUM benchmarks under two retrieval paradigms: flat chunk-based retrieval using IRCoT-style query refinement (Trivedi et al., 2023), and graph-based retrieval that constructs and iteratively enriches an entity-relation graph from the document. Across both settings, GRADRAG consistently outperforms one-step refinement baselines that update only the final generator, achieving a 12-15 percentage point net preference margin in LLM-judged pairwise comparisons, with most gains realized within two refinement iterations.
2607.21324.paper_summary_zh: 檢索增強生成（RAG）系統越來越多地使用多個大型語言模型（LLM）代理。<lb/>然而，大多數先前的工作都是孤立地優化組件，而不是協調整個流程中的改進。<lb/>我們介紹了GRADRAG，這是一個跨組件提示適應的框架，將RAG管道建模為計算圖，並傳播結構化的評估反饋以更新上游代理。<lb/>評估器對下游答案和支持證據進行批評，產生可操作的反饋，供提示優化器用來迭代更新自適應代理，如檢索器、圖構建器和回答者。<lb/>當輸出被認為令人滿意時，評估器還會觸發提前停止。<lb/>我們在SQUALITY和QMSUM基準上評估GRADRAG，並在兩種檢索範式下進行測試：使用IRCoT風格查詢優化的平坦塊基檢索（Trivedi等，2023），以及從文檔構建並迭代豐富實體-關係圖的基於圖的檢索。<lb/>在這兩種設置中，GRADRAG始終超越僅更新最終生成器的一步精煉基準，在LLM評判的成對比較中實現了12-15個百分點的淨偏好邊際，大多數增益在兩次精煉迭代內實現。
